description: Classify a Brazilian light electric vehicle under Resolução Contran 996/2023 art. 2 and tell whether it needs a licence plate. Categories: bicicleta_eletrica, autopropelido (no plate), ciclomotor (plate + ACC or CNH A), motocicleta (plate + CNH A).

largura_cm.description: Vehicle width in cm (needed for autopropelido)

tem_pedal.description: Pedal drives the wheel (true = pedal-assist bicycle)

name: classify_vehicle
